diagrams.title: The searcher keeps the whole conversation (`input_items`); the evaluator only ever sees the newest summary (`latest_outline`) — fresh eyes, fewer tokens
diagrams.caption: The searcher keeps the whole conversation (`input_items`); the evaluator only ever sees the newest summary (`latest_outline`) — fresh eyes, fewer tokens. The loop ends on "successful" or when the retry counter passes the limit.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 760 345" aria-label="Evaluator-optimizer loop. The user's request goes into input_items; the searcher agent with web search produces latest_outline; the evaluator fills a feedback form; if the score is successful the loop stops and prints; if unsuccessful the summary and feedback are appended to input_items and the searcher tries again, until a retry limit is reached." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <defs>
        <marker id="ev-m" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity=".6"></path></marker>
        <marker id="ev-mh" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" style="fill:#835c00"></path></marker>
      </defs>
      <g class="nd" id="ev-user"><rect x="10" y="44" width="120" height="60" rx="10" style="fill:#ffffff;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.38;stroke-width:1.3"></rect><text class="t13 b" x="70" y="70" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:13px;font-weight:700">User request</text><text class="mono t11 sub" x="70" y="90" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.68">msg</text></g>
      <g class="nd" id="ev-items"><rect x="170" y="44" width="150" height="60" rx="10" style="fill:#ffffff;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.38;stroke-width:1.3"></rect><text class="mono t13 b" x="245" y="70" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:13px;font-weight:700">input_items</text><text class="t11 sub" x="245" y="90" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.68">the searcher's chat</text></g>
      <g class="nd" id="ev-search"><rect x="360" y="44" width="170" height="60" rx="10" style="fill:#ffffff;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.38;stroke-width:1.3"></rect><text class="mono t13 b" x="445" y="70" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:13px;font-weight:700">web_news_searcher</text><text class="t11 sub" x="445" y="90" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.68">+ WebSearchTool</text></g>
      <g class="nd" id="ev-outline"><rect x="570" y="44" width="180" height="60" rx="10" style="fill:#ffffff;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.38;stroke-width:1.3"></rect><text class="mono t13 b" x="660" y="70" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:13px;font-weight:700">latest_outline</text><text class="t11 sub" x="660" y="90" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.68">newest summary text</text></g>
      <line class="ar" id="ev-a1" x1="130" y1="74" x2="168" y2="74" marker-end="url(#ev-m)" style="stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.55;stroke-width:1.5;fill:none"></line>
      <line class="ar" id="ev-a2" x1="320" y1="74" x2="358" y2="74" marker-end="url(#ev-m)" style="stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.55;stroke-width:1.5;fill:none"></line>
      <line class="ar" id="ev-a3" x1="530" y1="74" x2="568" y2="74" marker-end="url(#ev-m)" style="stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.55;stroke-width:1.5;fill:none"></line>
      <text class="alab" x="339" y="34" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.85">Runner.run</text>
      <text class="alab" x="549" y="34" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.85">new text</text>
      <line class="ar" id="ev-a4" x1="665" y1="104" x2="665" y2="178" marker-end="url(#ev-m)" style="stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.55;stroke-width:1.5;fill:none"></line>
      <text class="alab" x="655" y="146" text-anchor="end" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.85">only the new text</text>
      <g class="nd" id="ev-eval"><rect x="580" y="180" width="170" height="60" rx="10" style="fill:#ffffff;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.38;stroke-width:1.3"></rect><text class="mono t13 b" x="665" y="206" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:13px;font-weight:700">news_evaluator</text><text class="t11 sub" x="665" y="226" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.68">fills the feedback form</text></g>
      <line class="ar" id="ev-a5" x1="580" y1="210" x2="516" y2="210" marker-end="url(#ev-m)" style="stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.55;stroke-width:1.5;fill:none"></line>
      <text class="mono alab" x="548" y="200" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.85">result</text>
      <g class="nd" id="ev-dec"><path class="shape" d="M470,166 L514,210 L470,254 L426,210 Z" style="fill:#ffffff;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.38;stroke-width:1.3"></path><text class="mono t12 b" x="470" y="214" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px;font-weight:700">score?</text></g>
      <line class="ar" id="ev-a6" x1="426" y1="210" x2="332" y2="210" marker-end="url(#ev-m)" style="stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.55;stroke-width:1.5;fill:none"></line>
      <text class="alab" x="379" y="200" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.85">unsuccessful</text>
      <g class="nd" id="ev-fb"><rect x="130" y="180" width="200" height="60" rx="10" style="fill:#ffffff;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.38;stroke-width:1.3"></rect><text class="t12 b" x="230" y="205" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px;font-weight:700">append summary + feedback</text><text class="mono t11 sub" x="230" y="225" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.68">nbr_iterations += 1</text></g>
      <line class="ar" id="ev-a7" x1="240" y1="180" x2="240" y2="106" marker-end="url(#ev-m)" style="stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.55;stroke-width:1.5;fill:none"></line>
      <text class="alab" x="232" y="146" text-anchor="end" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.85">try again</text>
      <line class="ar" id="ev-a8" x1="470" y1="254" x2="470" y2="288" marker-end="url(#ev-m)" style="stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.55;stroke-width:1.5;fill:none"></line>
      <text class="alab" x="480" y="276" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.85">successful</text>
      <polyline class="ar" id="ev-a9" points="230,240 230,312 378,312" marker-end="url(#ev-m)" style="stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.55;stroke-width:1.5;fill:none"></polyline>
      <text class="mono alab" x="240" y="304" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.85">nbr_iterations > 4</text>
      <g class="nd" id="ev-stop"><rect x="380" y="290" width="180" height="44" rx="10" style="fill:#ffffff;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.38;stroke-width:1.3"></rect><text class="mono t12 b" x="470" y="317" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px;font-weight:700">print(latest_outline)</text></g>
    </svg>
